title: The Modal System: kell, lehet, muszáj

sections.title: Necessity and possibility in health advice
sections.content: You know *kell* and *muszáj* (A1, Unit 24), *lehet* (A1, Unit 30) and inflected infinitives (A2, Unit 21). In a general statement the infinitive stays plain: *Sok vizet kell inni.* When a person is named, the dative (*-nak / -nek*) goes on the person and the infinitive takes a personal ending: *Az embernek innia kell.*

items.spanish: Sok vizet kell inni a meleg nyári napokon.
items.english: One must drink plenty of water on hot summer days.

items.spanish: A rendelőben ma is lehet orvossal beszélni.
items.english: At the surgery, one can speak with a doctor today too.
